resources.string: CalDAV gateway to Exchange (EWS), on this phone only. Paste or import a DavMail properties file, then Save and start. In DAVx⁵ add an account with a base URL of http://127.0.0.1:PORT/principals/users/EMAIL/ and your Exchange user name and password; they stay on this phone. Exempt the app from battery optimisation so the gateway keeps running.
